messages:
amy_cust: Hey team — streaming from our Python client started hanging mid-response after ~10s. Generator yields nothing until connection closed. Not seeing errors on server side. Repro attached.
jordan_support: Sorry about that. Can you paste the minimal repro and the SDK version? Also any proxy/retry layers in front?
amy_cust: SDK 0.5.2, using requests + SSE backoff. We have an auth token refresher that swaps Authorization mid-stream when it nears expiry. No proxy. Minimal snippet:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=old_token)
for chunk in client.stream("chat.completions", model="open-llm", stream=True):
    print(chunk)
```
Logs show SSE fragments like:
```
data: {"delta":"Hel"

data: {"delta":"lo"}
```
then generator stalls until connection close.
leo_infra: Interesting — looks like the second event arrives as a separate packet but without final ``\n\n`` before the auth rotation. Does your token swap trigger a reconnect/retry at the HTTP layer?
amy_cust: The token swap calls client.update_api_key(new_token) which does a graceful reconnect: it sets a header on the next request but doesn't actively terminate existing long-poll. We rely on client to handle key rotation.
sara_eng: This rings a bell. In 0.5.x the SSE parser buffered until a full delimiter ("\n\n") before emitting an event; if auth rotation causes an intermediate 401+retry flow that reinserts partial data, the buffered fragment could be left waiting. Can you dump the raw bytes around the time it stalls?
amy_cust: Dump attached (hex and ascii). I see "data: {\"delta\":\"Hel\"\r\n" then keepalive \n then another chunk "\r\ndata: {\"delta\":\"lo\"}\n\n" but because keepalive was just "\n" the parser didn't see the double CRLF.
jordan_support: Thanks — that matches a known edge-case. Quick workaround: set client.sse_keepalive_delimiter = "\n" (temporary) or upgrade to 0.6.1 which fixes the parser to treat single-line keepalives specially and to yield partial events when upstream rotates auth instead of waiting indefinitely.
amy_cust: Any risk of duplicate tokens or repeated chunks with the upgrade? Our concern is we already implement retries and dedupe logic.
sara_eng: 0.6.1 also tweaks retry behavior: when a 401 triggers an auth refresh, the client will close the existing stream and transparently reconnect (avoids mixed fragments). That prevents duplicate partial-prefix emission. If you need a hotfix immediately, you can monkeypatch the parser to flush buffered data on auth-change hook:
```
# tiny patch
parser._flush_buffer_on_auth_change = True
```
Not pretty but effective until you can upgrade.
leo_infra: Also check your HTTP keepalive and any intermediate LB. We saw some LBs strip lone LF keepalives causing fragmentation. Ensure keepalives are CRLF or set the client to emit CRLFs.
amy_cust: Awesome — we patched to 0.6.1 and the hangs stopped. Noticed one case where we got a duplicated leading whitespace token on reconnect; rolled in a client-side dedupe and it's been stable.
jordan_support: Great news — marking as resolved. We'll follow up with a postmortem note in internal infra channel and add a KB entry.
deploy-bot: Release 0.6.1 deployed to hosted runtime (tags: sse-parser-fix, auth-rotate-reconnect). :shipit:
amy_cust: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
